o.en: [Term] Perform a case-sensitive search (Default is inSEnsITiVe).
[Term] Perform an EXACT match on exploit title (Default is AND) [Implies "-t"].
[EDB-ID] Mirror (aka copies) an exploit to the current working directory.
Exploit titles are allowed to overflow their columns.
[EDB-ID] Show the full path to an exploit (and also copies the path to the clipboard if possible).
[Term] Search JUST the exploit title (Default is title AND the file's path).
Check for and install any exploitdb package updates (deb or git).
[Term] Show URLs to Exploit-DB.com rather than the local path.

[EDB-ID] Examine (aka opens) the exploit using $PAGER. --disable-colour Disable colour highlighting in search results. --id Display the EDB-ID value rather than local path. --nmap [file.xml] Checks all results in Nmap's XML output with service version (e.g.: nmap -sV -oX file.xml).
